evidence.quote: Coral reefs harbour some of the most diverse species

criteria.reasoning: Well-written with headings and consistent formatting, readable style. Gantt has no number/caption/label, references are bare URLs not proper citation, software choice not headed, so below professional Accomplished.

technical_issues.issue: States 'geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km' - incorrect: GEO is ~35786 km; 600 km is LEO and cannot remain fixed above reef, GEO must be equatorial.
Proposes graveyard orbit / leave in place for 600 km LEO end-of-life; graveyard is GEO practice, LEO should de-orbit per debris guidelines.

overall: Good reef-monitoring rationale with feasible schedule but weak technical evidence and critical orbit misconception. Needs explicit software statement, sources list, and corrected orbit analysis with early results.
